mechanism_narrative: The ERBB2-MET novokine with GS_med linker (~20 Å flexible) forces two structurally asymmetric RTKs (ERBB2 ECD ~630 aa, MET ECD ~930 aa; ratio 1.48:1) into proximity, enabling transphosphorylation that synergistically activates SHC1→GRB2:SOS1→RAS→MAPK/ERK and GAB1→PI3K→AKT signaling axes, plus STAT3 activation via MET's multifunctional docking site (Y1349/Y1356). PLCG1 is sterically excluded due to the ~300 aa ECD asymmetry creating a geometry where PLCG1 cannot productively dock at the co-clustered intracellular domains. The biased output (MAPK↑, AKT↑, STAT3↑, PLCγ↓) promotes satellite cell activation, proliferation, and survival — a transcriptional program enriched in young skeletal muscle — while suppressing calcium-dependent signaling pathways associated with aged muscle dysfunction.
